text:
For **upper-upscale hotel conversions in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)**, owners typically consider a mix of **soft brands**—which preserve the hotel’s identity—and traditional “hard” brands with more prescriptive standards.

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**; also Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Renaissance and Le Méridien | Autograph and Tribute are especially prominent for independent resorts, historic hotels and lifestyle properties. Marriott reports strong CALA conversion activity supported by its collection brands. ([forbes.com](https://www.forbes.com/sites/ramseyqubein/2025/04/06/marriott-targets-latin-america-with-50-luxury-growth-planned/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**; also Hilton Hotels & Resorts, DoubleTree and Canopy | Curio is a leading candidate for distinctive full-service resorts; Tapestry can accommodate somewhat smaller or less service-intensive properties. Conversions accounted for nearly 30% of Hilton’s 2024 CALA signings. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-wraps-2024-with-record-portfolio-and-pipeline-growth-in-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **voco**, **Hotel Indigo**, **Crowne Plaza**; **Vignette Collection** for higher-end assets | voco and Crowne Plaza suit conventional full-service conversions; Indigo suits neighborhood-oriented lifestyle hotels; Vignette targets distinctive luxury/lifestyle properties. IHG explicitly identifies these as conversion-friendly brands. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, Hyatt Regency; sometimes JdV by Hyatt | Unbound and Destination are the principal independent-collection options. Hyatt Regency is more appropriate where the property can meet standardized full-service requirements. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/UnboundAnniversaryGrowth2026?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection**; also Pullman, Mövenpick and Swissôtel in suitable markets | MGallery is Accor’s clearest upper-upscale soft-brand conversion option and is designed for distinctive, locally influenced hotels. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Dolce Hotels & Resorts by Wyndham** | Registry is an upper-upscale soft brand, particularly relevant to independent leisure and all-inclusive resorts; Dolce works well for full-service resorts and meetings-oriented hotels. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels/Radisson Americas** | **Radisson Individuals**, Radisson Blu | Radisson Individuals is positioned specifically as an upper-upscale soft brand for boutique and independent full-service hotels. ([investor.choicehotels.com](https://investor.choicehotels.com/news/news-details/2024/Choice-Hotels-relaunches-Radisson-Individuals-as-part-of-its-portfolio-of-brands-adding-a-distinctive-proposition-to-the-upper-upscale-segment/default.aspx?utm_source=openai)) |

### Most typical initial shortlist

For an existing independent upper-upscale hotel, the brands most often worth testing first are:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Tribute Portfolio**
3. **Curio Collection by Hilton**
4. **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**
5. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
6. **voco**
7. **Hotel Indigo**
8. **MGallery Collection**
9. **Registry Collection Hotels**
10. **Radisson Individuals**

For a **large conventional urban or group hotel**, also test **Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Hilton, Hyatt Regency, Crowne Plaza, Pullman and Radisson Blu**.

For an **all-inclusive resort**, the field expands to include **Curio and Autograph all-inclusive formats**, plus Hyatt’s **Dreams, Secrets, Zoëtry, Hyatt Ziva and Hyatt Zilara** brands, depending on positioning and adult/family mix. Hyatt has been particularly active in expanding its all-inclusive portfolio throughout Mexico and the Caribbean. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124291&utm_source=openai))

Actual suitability generally depends on room count and size, renovation scope, restaurants and meeting space, resort amenities, market exclusivity, franchise versus management availability, distribution contribution and the owner’s willingness to adopt brand standards. Exact “upper-upscale” classification can also vary among STR, lenders and the hotel companies themselves.
